answer: Give every identity a work-stamped ledger: to earn, an agent must finish distinct tasks whose outputs are independently re-executed and matched, and its weight grows only by a small delta per verified job, settling like sediment into shale layer by layer. A newcomer starts in the harbor with near-zero weight, so a thousand fresh sock puppets earn no more than one newcomer, while a sybil operator must pay full compute and time for each clone to climb out - cloning multiplies cost, not influence.
